sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Sweet Merge Puzzle is a match-three puzzle game where you swap candies to create sets of three or more in a row. However, as you progress through the levels, the game introduces new candies, power-ups, and game modes that add depth and complexity to the gameplay. The game's unique candy evolution system allows you to merge and evolve candies into increasingly more complex and spectacular treats. With 12 unique tiers to progress through, you'll unlock new candies, power-ups, and game modes, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.

One of the key mechanics in Sweet Merge Puzzle is the use of power candies. These special candies can be used strategically to clear entire rows or columns, create massive combos, or even destroy obstacles. However, they can also be a double-edged sword, as using them too frequently can lead to a decrease in your score. As you progress through the levels, you'll need to learn when to use your power candies wisely in order to maximize your score and progress.

Another important aspect of the gameplay is the use of Sugar Rush combos. These combos occur when you merge three or more candies in a row, creating a chain reaction that clears the entire row. Sugar Rush combos are essential for clearing the board quickly and efficiently, and can earn you a significant amount of points. However, they can also be a challenge to achieve, especially on higher difficulty levels.
